description: Free. Use it to swap a graduated pons token on Robinhood Chain: returns the UNSIGNED KyberSwap transaction to sign. side.description: buy (spend ETH for the token, default) or sell (sell the token for ETH)

slippage_pct.description: Slippage in percent: default 1, at most 5, at most two decimals

token.description: 0x address of a graduated pons v2 token on Robinhood Chain (42 characters)

wallet.description: 0x address that will sign and receive; put in the calldata as sender and recipient
